title: review-jev-contract: an additional orchestrator reviewer that checks a PR's description claims and the flow's acceptance criteria against the diff

AC1.note: src/review/jev-contract.ts (engine module), jev-contract-config.ts, review-jev-contract.ts (adapter); jev-contract.test.ts (28 tests). Registered like jev-risk/-docs: src/commands/review.ts case+USAGE, catalog.ts skill() entry, SKILL.md (bundled+installed byte-identical).

AC2.note: keryx review jev-contract (--pr <n>|--diff <ref>) [--flow <id>] [--json] implemented in src/commands/review-jev-contract.ts::runJevContract; usage-error and happy-path tests in review-jev-contract-cli.test.ts pass.

AC3.note: extractClaims() in jev-contract.ts splits bullets unconditionally and prose sentences by verb-cue regex; 8 unit tests cover bullets, numbered lists, checkboxes, verb-cue sentences, no-claim, multi-claim mixed, code-fence exclusion, dedup. Live check on PR #726/#727 extracted 5 and 4 claims respectively.

AC4.note: review-jev-contract.ts imports runCheckAc from ./flow-check-ac (which reaches check-ac.ts only via src/flow/service.ts) for --flow's AC track; also imports extractCriterionTokens/computeAcFacts-family via service.ts for claim facts. No check-ac.ts logic duplicated. Live-checked: --flow 332 and --flow 333 both merged acCheck with AC1..AC10 verdicts into the jev-contract output.

AC5.note: computeClaimFacts() computes tokens present/absent (via extractCriterionTokens), testFilesInDiff for tests-added claims, exportedSymbolsChanged via touchedExportedSymbols (jev-risk.ts) for API-shaped no-change claims; all present per-claim in JSON output (claims[].intent, budget). Unit tests + live check confirm these facts appear in real output.

AC6.note: batchContractClaimItems asks exactly one noul per claim; synthesizeContractFindings: contradicted facts -> major with class_scope object (schema-valid, revert-checked: breaking class_scope shape fails the CLI schema test); below-threshold noul -> minor. Unit tests cover both severities; CLI test validates against reviewer-finding.schema.json.

AC7.note: readJevContractEnabled (review.jev.contract) gates the CLI/TUI; jevContractGateRefusal tested opt-in-off and no-credential paths. Orchestrator side: SKILL.md's 'This gate owns the description-vs-diff comparison' section and SKILL.detail.md's CLI-engine reviewers section document the opt-in-on replacement / opt-in-off fallback; no code change was needed in the by-eye path since it is prose-governed, matching how jev-risk/-docs integrate.

AC8.note: All content is redacted via redactSensitiveText from src/security/service.ts before it reaches state/questions text (renderClaimState, questionForClaim, jev-contract.ts). No ad hoc redaction added.

AC9.note: budget object {maxCalls, claimsScored, claimsSkipped} and tokens {jevCalls, inputTokens, outputTokens, costUsd} reported in both --json and prose (renderContractMarkdown); --max-calls truncation test confirms claimsSkipped is reported. Live check on PR #726 hit a real vendor max_tokens_exceeded on one batch; jevError field reports it and the run degrades gracefully rather than aborting (revert-checked: reverting the per-batch try/catch would have crashed the whole command, as it did before the fix).

AC10.note: docs/docs/cli-reference.md (table rows + 'review jev-contract' section), HELP_GROUPS (/contract entry), commands-by-task.md regenerated via scripts/generate-commands-by-task.ts, skill catalogs (.metaproject/skills/catalog.md, modules/gdskills.md, src/gdskills/catalog.ts), skill-length-ceilings.ts (new entry 193, review-orchestrator/SKILL.md held at exactly 1723 via in-place edits), routing-corpus.ts case (RANK1_FIRST/TOTAL 328/330 -> 332/334), bundled skill counts (77->78 in bundled-eval.test.ts and skills.bundled-verify.test.ts). SKILL.md/SKILL.detail.md bundled and installed copies verified byte-identical via diff. src/commands/review.ts USAGE gained jev-risk/jev-scenarios/jev-contract lines. /contract wired in tui-shell.ts, agent-commands.ts.
